purpose: Collect recent Jev, decision-model and System One papers from WeChat, Zhihu, Sina Weibo and X, then verify against original arXiv records and deduplicate.
recency: Queries targeted 2026-10-17 through 2026-10-27; discovery date is not paper submission date.

queries.query: site:zhihu.com Jev 决策模型 arxiv

outcomes.note: All 48 additions on 2026-10-27 came from the arXiv API sweep of 2026-10-17..26 submissions. Social channels produced no additional verifiable arXiv records.

cross_checks.disposition: Three already included; 2609.14811 recorded as excluded (crypto accounting benchmark, no Jev or decision-model evaluation).

cross_checks.lead: Post attributed to @rohanpaul_ai (10/25) on a University of Texas paper about fast scoring with reusable agent memory
cross_checks.disposition: Matches the included Iris paper (arXiv:2610.33702) from the arXiv sweep; no separate record.

unresolved_leads.lead: WeChat article 《Jev 决策模型遇上电车难题：提示措辞为何会改变生死选择》 (account 屠荒者), comparing Jev and OpenAI Decisions Luna on trolley-problem prompt sensitivity
unresolved_leads.disposition: No arXiv record located; original article body not read. Kept unresolved; do not treat as a paper.

platform_limitations: Zhihu direct search returned HTTP 403 and Bing site: filters were ignored, so Zhihu coverage is an access gap, not evidence of absence.
Weibo public search remained robots-restricted as in the 2026-10-17 round; no verifiable paper leads.
The Sogou 'Jev' query is dominated by the Journal of Extracellular Vesicles (JEV), an unrelated acronym.
WeChat results were product news and tutorials (e.g., Jev-class model launches, UI-automation practice), not research papers.
